strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 9.38 'Bilanzierungsdaten für die Umwandlung von 1 kg NOx in N2', column 'SCR-Abscheidung', per 1 kg NOx; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: The extra electricity consumption caused by the pressure drop over the catalyst (about 0.35 % of net output) is explicitly booked on the power plant's net efficiency, not on this module.
The building effort for storage tanks is explicitly booked with the power plant construction, so no infrastructure appears here.
The production of the catalyst coating is explicitly not inventoried ('Die Produktion der Katalysatorbeschichtung wird nicht weiter bilanziert').
No N2 or water output is booked, and no N2O side-product.
